task: MuseScore 3 is open with /home/user/Documents/swell.mscz (4 measures). Add a crescendo hairpin spanning measures 1 through 2, and a decrescendo hairpin spanning measures 3 through 4. Save in place.

cli_feasibility.translation: Unzip .mscz file, parse XML, add <Hairpin><subtype>0</subtype></Hairpin> (0=crescendo, 1=decrescendo) spanner element, repackage
cli_feasibility.reason: Adding hairpin dynamics is inserting XML spanner elements - can be done with Python stdlib in ~35 lines
